**Implementation note:** This is volatility-ai's own design: independent lots, per-lot targets, never sold below cost (no_loss_guard). RSI-scaled lots are V3; volatility-scaled steps are C-G3.

## Description

Deploys independent, un-merged fractional inventory lots using dynamic RSI/volatility grid steps, setting rigid per-lot profit targets and enforcing 'never sell at a loss'.

## Where it may fit

High-volatility range-bound or mean-reverting equity/ETF instruments (e.g. TQQQ, SOXL, crypto).

## Vehicles

Retail algorithmic accounts, systematic crypto funds, volatility harvesting vehicles.

## Required data

Real-time quote/trade stream, sliding window RSI indicators, ATR/historical volatility, lot-level inventory ledger.

## Caveats

Prolonged bear trends lock up capital in 'stuck lots' until prices recover; requires capital allocation rules and drawdown governors to prevent cash exhaustion.
